name: RPG Companion HMS 1.5.1 — Observer & Compatible Active
author: TenderTriper (Perch) — HMS Edition. Based on RPG Companion by Marinara. Minds, agendas, who knows what, Chekhov’s gun and building maps from FrankenSIM by Wireless (Ryah); TFDY by Pyropia.
description: Selectable Observer (default): reads the current campaign WORLD STATE without prompt injection, AI calls or message edits. Compatible Active keeps panel tools with optional bounded panel requests; no cached scene or narrative-style injection. New starts isolate campaign state; arc contradictions are reported, not silently corrected. Existing credits, identifier and legacy storage are preserved. See UPDATE-1.5.0.md.
